request.title: Send a request
request.text: Best for flash picks and custom ideas. Tell me what and where, attach references, and I'll reply with a quote and dates.

square.title: Book on Square
square.text: Already know what you want and when? Grab a slot straight from the calendar. The deposit is paid there.

instagram.title: DM on Instagram
instagram.text: Quick questions, walk-in checks, or if forms aren't your thing. DMs are always welcome.

form.notesPlaceholder: Flash you picked, or describe your idea
form.daysPlaceholder: Mondays, or any Tuesday in November
form.replyNote: I usually reply within a couple of days.

thanks.heading: Got it.
thanks.text: Your request is in. I'll reply with a quote and available dates, usually within a couple of days.
